summary: Designed the function purity contract for DSL-08. The design artefact at src/design/dsl-08-function-purity.md defines the purity contract for all 11 built-in functions, classifies 10 as pure and 1 (now()) as impure (explicitly exempted), provides a determinism test strategy with 24 test cases using a call-twice-compare pattern, details enforcement mechanisms (compile-time and review-time), documents the now() exemption with rationale, and includes a full test matrix, error taxonomy, data flow diagram, and dependency analysis. All 5 acceptance criteria are met.
